name: rfd4-proteina

settings.name: task
settings.description: The design problem to solve.

settings.name: modelCheckpoint
settings.description: Choose the general model or the antibody-specialized checkpoint for CDR design. Antibody weights: https://huggingface.co/nvidia/RFD4-Proteina/blob/main/antibody/rfd4-proteina-antibody-2026-10-30-ema.ckpt

settings.name: structureOperation
settings.description: What to do with the structure you upload.

settings.name: conditionsFrom
settings.description: Whether you give the conditions as a separate file or already inside an annotated CIF.

settings.name: pdbFile
settings.description: The target, motif or backbone to design against or around. PDB or mmCIF (.cif); use mmCIF with ligands or a motif, since a PDB cannot hold bond orders or charges.

settings.name: conditionSpec
settings.description: YAML or JSON for one design: the chains to build and the conditions to apply, numbered as in your file. Base pairs can't be set here; the example lists the options.

settings.name: structureFiles
settings.description: PDB or mmCIF (.cif) structures to score, up to 100 per job. Each file name labels its row.

settings.name: designType
settings.description: What kind of design the structures are; it sets the checks and pass limits.

settings.name: designedChain
settings.description: The chain you designed; every other chain, ligand or DNA counts as the target. Use the same chain letter in every structure.

settings.name: secondaryStructure
settings.description: One character per residue, 8 to 1024 (over 256 is beyond training). ( ) pair, . is unpaired, ? is left to the model; [ ] { } < > or letter pairs like Aa mark pseudoknots.

settings.name: minLength
settings.description: Shortest chain to generate, in residues.

settings.name: maxLength
settings.description: Longest chain to generate, in residues.

settings.name: foldClass
settings.description: CATH code to steer the fold, in the full class.architecture.topology form such as 2.60.40 (immunoglobulin).

settings.name: designedLengths
settings.description: New protein to add before, between and after the kept residues, one row per gap in order. Gaps without a row get 10 to 20 residues.

settings.name: minScaffoldLength
settings.description: Fewest residues in the whole protein, catalytic residues included, instead of per gap; the model must place the motif. Blank: 180, as in the model's enzyme benchmark.

settings.name: maxScaffoldLength
settings.description: Most residues in the whole protein, catalytic residues included, when the model places the motif; one bound alone fixes the length. Blank: 180, as in the model's enzyme benchmark.

settings.name: nanobodyFramework
settings.description: The nanobody to design the three loops on: a built-in framework or your own.

settings.name: antibodyFramework
settings.description: The antibody Fv to design the six loops on: a built-in framework or your own.

settings.name: frameworkFile
settings.description: Your nanobody, or your antibody's heavy and light chains, apart from the target. PDB or uncompressed mmCIF (.cif). Blank: they are in the input structure with the target.

settings.name: frameworkChains
settings.description: Chains of the framework structure to use: one for a nanobody, heavy then light for an antibody. Blank uses every protein chain in it.

settings.name: targetChains
settings.description: Target chains; for Inverse Folding and Side Chain Packing, chains to redesign or repack. Required for TCR and for an antibody or nanobody in one structure with its target; otherwise blank uses every protein chain.

settings.name: igChains
settings.description: Chains that hold the variable domain to redesign: one for a nanobody, heavy and light for an antibody, alpha and beta for a TCR. With a framework structure, its chains; blank finds them.

settings.name: cdrResidues
settings.description: Residues of the loops to replace, one CDR per separate stretch, in order; blank finds the standard CDRs. With a framework structure, its residues.

settings.name: cdrLengths
settings.description: Length range per CDR in order from CDR1, then the second chain's CDRs for an antibody or TCR. CDRs without a row keep their length (built-in nanobody: 13, 9 to 10, 12 to 21; built-in antibody: H1 13, H2 10, H3 11 to 17, L1 11, L2 8, L3 9).

settings.name: minBinderLength
settings.description: Shortest binder to generate, in residues.

settings.name: maxBinderLength
settings.description: Longest binder to generate, in residues. Very large systems can lower quality; the target counts toward the size.

settings.name: hotspotResidues
settings.description: Target residues the binder should contact.

settings.name: hotspotAtoms
settings.description: Which atoms of each hotspot residue to mark.

settings.name: repackTargetInterface
settings.description: Lets the model re-place target side chains around the new binder.

settings.name: frameworkAtoms
settings.description: Which atoms of the framework to keep fixed. The framework sequence is always kept.

settings.name: separateIgChains
settings.description: Lets the model place each variable chain on its own. Off keeps the pairing geometry of your structure.

settings.name: keepConstantDomains
settings.description: Holds constant domains and tags if your structure has them. Off keeps only the variable domain, as trained, and reports what was removed.

settings.name: motifResidues
settings.description: Residues to hold fixed while new protein is built around them.

settings.name: motifAtoms
settings.description: Which atoms of the motif to keep fixed.

settings.name: catalyticAtoms
settings.description: Which atoms of the catalytic residues to keep fixed.

settings.name: catalyticAtomPicks
settings.description: Hold exactly these atoms of chosen catalytic residues, such as A102:CG,OD2 A195:NE2. Use 1:102:CG for a chain named by a digit.

settings.name: unindexMotif
settings.description: Lets the model choose where the motif sits in the new sequence. Off fixes its position.

settings.name: fixMotifSequence
settings.description: Keeps the motif's amino acids as well as its backbone. Off keeps the shape and lets the model choose residues.

settings.name: ligandCode
settings.description: Residue codes of the ligands and ions to design around, such as SAM, ATP, MG. Others are removed; blank keeps all but crystallization additives such as glycerol, sulfate and PEG, which are always removed.

settings.name: ligandHandling
settings.description: Whether the ligand pose is generated with the protein or held as uploaded.

settings.name: ligandHoldAtoms
settings.description: Ligand atoms to hold where they are in your file, such as O2, C5. The rest of the ligand is left free. Write SAM:O2 for several ligands.

settings.name: ligandHbondDonors
settings.description: Ligand atoms that should donate a hydrogen bond to the new protein, such as N3, O4. Write SAM:N3 for several ligands.

settings.name: ligandHbondAcceptors
settings.description: Ligand atoms that should accept a hydrogen bond from the new protein, such as O2, N7. Write SAM:O2 for several ligands.

settings.name: ligandBurial
settings.description: How buried the ligand should be in the protein.

settings.name: ligandExposedAtoms
settings.description: Ligand atoms to keep exposed (relative accessible surface above 0.1), such as where a linker attaches. Names as in your file, like N6, O2'; write SAM:N6 for several ligands.

settings.name: ligandInteractions
settings.description: Ask the design to make a specific contact with named ligand atoms, such as accepting a hydrogen bond at a carbonyl oxygen.

settings.name: dnaContext
settings.description: Whether the DNA conformation is generated with the binder or held as uploaded.

settings.name: keepChains
settings.description: Chains held fixed in position and sequence while the rest is re-noised, such as a target when rescuing a binder.

settings.name: partialMode
settings.description: How the amount of change is set.

settings.name: noiseLevel
settings.description: Fraction of the sampling steps to re-run, 0.05 to 1. Higher changes more of the input and 1 regenerates it.

settings.name: partialBackboneLevel
settings.description: Backbone to keep, 0.01 to 0.99. Higher stays closer to the input.

settings.name: partialLatentLevel
settings.description: Sequence and side chains to keep, 0.01 to 0.99. Higher stays closer to the input.

settings.name: redesignShell
settings.description: Residues more than this many Å from the kept chains (and from the ligand, when measured from it) stay fixed; nearer ones are redesigned. Blank redesigns every residue that is not kept.

settings.name: sequenceShell
settings.description: Distance in Å from the kept chains within which the sequence may change. Blank uses the Redesign Shell.

settings.name: backboneShell
settings.description: Distance in Å from the kept chains within which the backbone may move. Blank uses the Redesign Shell.

settings.name: shellFromLigand
settings.description: Also measures the shells from the ligand (and any metal) and holds it fixed, to redesign the pocket around it. The structure must contain a ligand.

settings.name: fixedResidues
settings.description: Residues to keep unchanged while the rest is redesigned.

settings.name: keepFixedResiduesInPlace
settings.description: Keeps the residues you chose exactly as uploaded, atoms included. Off keeps only their amino acid.

settings.name: helixResidues
settings.description: Residues that should come out as helix.

settings.name: strandResidues
settings.description: Residues that should come out as beta strand.

settings.name: loopResidues
settings.description: Residues that should come out as loop.

settings.name: numDesigns
settings.description: Number of designs to generate. A production campaign is ~1,000 designs; try ~100 first. Above 100 splits into several jobs; Reward Search allows at most 16.

settings.name: samplingEffort
settings.description: How much computation to spend refining each design.

settings.name: samplingSteps
settings.description: Sampling steps per design, 60 to 120. The paper uses 60; other values can change quality.

settings.name: searchPreset
settings.description: Makes several candidates per design and keeps the best by a built-in reward.

settings.name: searchBeamWidth
settings.description: How many of the best candidates the search keeps after each scoring round, 1 to 4. You get this many designs back for each design you request.

settings.name: searchBranches
settings.description: How many new candidates each kept candidate spawns before the next scoring round, 1 to 4. More branches search more widely; Best by refolding needs at least 2.

settings.name: deterministicSampling
settings.description: Samples without added noise, so the same seed gives matching designs to within sampling tolerance.

settings.name: backboneTemperature
settings.description: Backbone noise while sampling, 0.01 to 1.5. Higher gives more varied folds and can lower designability.

settings.name: sequenceTemperature
settings.description: Sequence and side-chain noise while sampling, 0.01 to 5. Higher gives more varied sequences.

settings.name: seed
settings.description: Repeats a run to within sampling tolerance. Blank gives a new result each time.

settings.name: tsrBackboneK
settings.description: How far temporal score rescaling (TSR) lowers the backbone sampling temperature by the end of sampling. Higher lowers it more.

settings.name: tsrBackboneSigma
settings.description: How fast temporal score rescaling (TSR) reaches its lowest backbone sampling temperature. Higher is faster.

settings.name: tsrLatentK
settings.description: How far temporal score rescaling (TSR) lowers the sequence and side-chain sampling temperature by the end of sampling. Higher lowers it more.

settings.name: tsrLatentSigma
settings.description: How fast temporal score rescaling (TSR) reaches its lowest sequence and side-chain sampling temperature. Higher is faster.

settings.name: excludeAminoAcids
settings.description: Amino acids to avoid, such as cysteine. A bias, not a ban: one can still appear where the input structure calls for it, such as a disulfide. Kept residues are unaffected, and antibody, nanobody and TCR design bias only the new loops.

settings.name: favorAminoAcids
settings.description: Amino acids to favor, such as tryptophan and tyrosine, each as a percent of positions. A bias, not a guarantee; the percents add up to 100 or less.

settings.name: clusterDesigns
settings.description: Groups designs by structure with Foldseek and adds a cluster ID, plus the clustered pass rate for tasks with pass limits. Jobs split from a large request are clustered separately.

settings.name: preOracleFilters
settings.description: Removes designs that break a condition you set, such as a changed fixed sequence, or that contain an unknown residue, before they are scored. Off keeps every design you asked for.

settings.name: refoldDesigns
settings.description: Re-predicts each design from its sequence with OpenFold3 and compares it with the design, adding refold metrics and, for tasks with pass limits, the pass columns.

settings.name: passInterfacePae
settings.description: Highest interface error, in Å, at which a refolded design counts as passed. Blank uses the authors' limit: 1.5 Å, or 2.0 Å for nanobodies.

settings.name: passBackboneRmsd
settings.description: Highest backbone RMSD, in Å, between a design and its refold to count as passed. Blank uses the authors' limit: 1.5 Å, or 2.0 Å for motif scaffolding and enzymes.

settings.name: passBinderRmsd
settings.description: Highest binder RMSD, in Å, between a design and its refold, aligned on the target. Blank uses the authors' limit: 2.5 Å for binders, 2.0 Å for nanobodies, 8.0 Å for DNA binders.

settings.name: passMotifRmsd
settings.description: Highest all-atom motif RMSD, in Å, between a design and its refold. Blank uses the authors' limit: 2.0 Å for motif scaffolding, 1.5 Å for enzymes.

settings.name: avoidTargetFiles
settings.description: Related proteins the binder should not bind, such as other family members. Up to 6 across both lists.

settings.name: alsoBindTargetFiles
settings.description: Other versions of the target the binder should also bind, such as the same protein from another species. Up to 6 across both lists.

settings.name: checkApoFold
settings.description: Folds each binder on its own, without the target, and reports how far its shape moves; lower means it keeps its shape.

settings.name: interfaceEnergy
settings.description: Adds the physics-based energy of the contacts between the binder and its target or ligand. Lower is more favorable.

settings.name: developabilityMetrics
settings.description: Adds GRAVY (average hydrophobicity, lower is more soluble) and the instability index (below 40 predicts a stable protein). Both are left blank for multi-chain designs.

settings.name: saveTrajectory
settings.description: Saves the generation path as a C-alpha trajectory, one frame every 10 steps. If saving fails, the job reruns without it.

description: Generates protein structure and sequence together, from scratch or around a target, motif or ligand.

columns.name: design_id
columns.description: Identifier for this design within the job.

columns.name: task
columns.description: The design task this design was generated for.

columns.name: output_pdb
columns.description: Generated structure for this design.

columns.name: output_cif
columns.description: Same design in mmCIF, which additionally records which part of the input each atom came from.

columns.name: sequence
columns.description: Amino-acid sequence of the chain the model designed, so the table can be read without opening the structure.

columns.name: chain_of_interest
columns.description: Chain ID of the designed chain in the output structure.

columns.name: passed
columns.description: 1 if the refolded design met every criterion the model's authors use for this task, 0 if it missed one, blank if it could not be judged.

columns.name: limits_used
columns.description: The limits behind the Passed column, with the ones you changed marked. The same on every row.

columns.name: clash_metrics.frac_atoms_clashing_1p5A
columns.description: Fraction of atoms sitting closer than 1.5 angstroms to another atom. A physically sensible design is near zero.

columns.name: bond_length_metrics.bond_length.frac_unreasonable
columns.description: Fraction of bonds that are longer than a physical bond can be for their elements. Bonds that are too short are not counted.

columns.name: sequence_adherence.n_violations
columns.description: Number of residues you fixed whose amino acid changed in the design. Zero means every fixed residue was kept.

columns.name: sequence_adherence.sequence_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of the residues you fixed that kept their amino acid. One means every constraint was met.

columns.name: hotspot_obedience.hotspot_obedience
columns.description: Fraction of the hotspot atoms you marked that have a binder atom within 4.5 Å. Only meaningful when hotspots were given.

columns.name: design_motif_allatom_rmsd.rmsd
columns.description: All-atom deviation, in angstroms, between the motif you held fixed and where it ended up in the design. Lower is closer to what you asked for.

columns.name: design_unindexed_motif_allatom_rmsd.rmsd
columns.description: The same deviation, in angstroms, restricted to motif atoms whose position in the sequence the model chose.

columns.name: unindexed_insertion_mapping.n_unmapped_tokens
columns.description: Number of motif residues the model did not place in the designed chain. Zero means every one was placed.

columns.name: unindexed_insertion_mapping.n_sequence_mismatches
columns.description: Number of placed motif residues whose amino acid differs from the one you asked for.

columns.name: motif_residue_map
columns.description: Where each motif residue of your input ended up in the designed chain, as input residue to output residue.

columns.name: ca_rmsd_to_input.rmsd
columns.description: Backbone deviation, in angstroms, between this design and your input over C-alpha atoms. Lower means closer to your input; for Structure Prediction, how far the predicted fold is from yours.

columns.name: sequence_similarity_to_input.sequence_identity_to_input
columns.description: Fraction of positions where the designed sequence matches your input, 0 to 1. Higher means more of the input was kept.

columns.name: contact_molecular_surface.contact_ms
columns.description: Distance-weighted contact surface between the designed chain and its target. Higher means more contact.

columns.name: contact_molecular_surface.contact_ms_binder
columns.description: The same contact surface measured from the binder side.

columns.name: identity_to_target
columns.description: Highest fraction of positions, from 0 to 1, where the designed chain matches an ungapped, same-length stretch of a protein target chain. Near 1 means a copy of the target. Blank without a target.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.hbond_atom_pair_count_coi
columns.description: Number of hydrogen-bonded atom pairs between the designed chain and everything else in the system.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.saltbridge_residue_pair_count_coi
columns.description: Number of salt-bridged residue pairs between the designed chain and its partner.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.hydrophobic_atom_pair_count_coi
columns.description: Number of hydrophobic atom pairs across the interface the designed chain makes.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.pistack_residue_pair_count_coi
columns.description: Number of pi-stacked residue pairs between the designed chain and its partner.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.pication_residue_pair_count_coi
columns.description: Number of cation-pi residue pairs between the designed chain and its partner.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.metal_coord_atom_pair_count_coi
columns.description: Number of metal-coordinating atom pairs between the designed chain and its partner.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.hbond_donor_conditioning_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of atoms you asked to donate a hydrogen bond that do. Only reported when you set hydrogen bond conditions.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.hbond_acceptor_conditioning_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of atoms you asked to accept a hydrogen bond that do. Only reported when you set hydrogen bond conditions.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.hbond_simultaneous_donor_acceptor_conditioning_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of atoms you asked to both donate and accept that do both, in different bonds.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.pistack_conditioning_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of the rings you asked to pi-stack that do. Only reported when you set this condition.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.pication_aromatic_conditioning_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of the rings you asked to take part in a cation-pi contact that do.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.pication_cation_conditioning_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of the cations you asked to take part in a cation-pi contact that do.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.saltbridge_conditioning_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of the atoms you asked to form a salt bridge that do. Only reported when you set this condition.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.hydrophobic_conditioning_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of the atoms you asked to make a hydrophobic contact that do. Only reported when you set this condition.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.metal_coord_conditioning_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of the atoms you asked to coordinate a metal that do. Only reported when you set this condition.

columns.name: rasa_adherence.buried_conditioning_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of the residues or ligand atoms you asked to be buried that are. Only reported when you set burial conditions.

columns.name: rasa_adherence.intermediate_conditioning_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of the residues or ligand atoms you asked to be partly buried that are.

columns.name: rasa_adherence.exposed_conditioning_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of the residues or ligand atoms you asked to be exposed that are.

columns.name: centroid_conditioning_adherence.centroid_conditioning_mae
columns.description: Average distance, in angstroms, between the chain centroid you requested and where it ended up. Lower is closer.

columns.name: sequence_probability_adherence.zero_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of your amino acid exclusions that the design respected. One means no excluded amino acid appears where you excluded it.

columns.name: sequence_probability_adherence.n_zero_violations
columns.description: Number of times an excluded amino acid appears at a position where you excluded it.

columns.name: sequence_probability_adherence.one_adherence
columns.description: Fraction of the positions where you required one amino acid that got it. Only reported when you set this condition.

columns.name: sequence_probability_adherence.n_one_violations
columns.description: Number of positions where you required one amino acid and got another.

columns.name: foldseek_cluster_id
columns.description: Cluster ID from Foldseek. Designs with the same ID have similar folds. Only reported with Cluster Designs.

columns.name: cluster_diversity
columns.description: Distinct structural clusters divided by the number of designs, 0 to 1. Higher means a more diverse set. Only reported with Cluster Designs.

columns.name: clustered_pass_rate
columns.description: Distinct structure clusters among the designs that passed, divided by the designs attempted, from 0 to 1. The same on every row. Closer to 1 means more varied successes.

columns.name: clusters_passed
columns.description: Number of distinct structure clusters among the designs that passed. The same on every row.

columns.name: cdr_sequences
columns.description: The residues the model designed in each loop you replaced, one entry per loop in order along each chain, for example H-CDR1:GRTFSYNP;H-CDR2:ISRTGGST.

columns.name: sse_distribution.helix_fraction_coi
columns.description: Fraction of the designed chain that folded into helix.

columns.name: sse_distribution.sheet_fraction_coi
columns.description: Fraction of the designed chain that folded into sheet.

columns.name: sse_distribution.loop_fraction_coi
columns.description: Fraction of the designed chain that is loop rather than helix or sheet.

columns.name: designed_chain
columns.description: Chain ID of the designed chain in the structure files. Several chains are joined with colons, in the order of the sequence.

columns.name: sse_distribution.num_ss_elements_coi
columns.description: Number of separate helix, sheet and loop segments along the designed chain.

columns.name: sse_distribution.helix_fraction
columns.description: Fraction of every protein chain in the structure, target included, that is helix.

columns.name: sse_distribution.sheet_fraction
columns.description: Fraction of every protein chain in the structure, target included, that is sheet.

columns.name: sse_distribution.loop_fraction
columns.description: Fraction of every protein chain in the structure, target included, that is loop.

columns.name: sse_distribution.num_ss_elements
columns.description: Number of separate helix, sheet and loop segments along every protein chain in the structure.

columns.name: n_unmapped_tokens
columns.description: Number of motif residues you gave that could not be found in the design. Zero means all were located.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.hbond_atom_count_coi
columns.description: Number of atoms in the designed chain that take part in hydrogen bonds with other chains.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.pistack_residue_count_coi
columns.description: Number of residues in the designed chain that pi-stack with another chain.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.pication_residue_count_coi
columns.description: Number of residues in the designed chain that make a pi-cation contact with another chain.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.saltbridge_residue_count_coi
columns.description: Number of residues in the designed chain that form a salt bridge with another chain.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.hydrophobic_atom_count_coi
columns.description: Number of atoms in the designed chain that make hydrophobic contacts with other chains.

columns.name: interchain_interactions.metal_coord_atom_count_coi
columns.description: Number of atoms in the designed chain that coordinate a metal held by another chain.

columns.name: sse_accuracy.overall_accuracy
columns.description: Fraction of the residues you gave a secondary structure that came out as asked.

columns.name: sse_accuracy.helix_recall
columns.description: Fraction of the residues you asked to be helix that came out helix.

columns.name: sse_accuracy.sheet_recall
columns.description: Fraction of the residues you asked to be sheet that came out sheet.

columns.name: sse_accuracy.loop_recall
columns.description: Fraction of the residues you asked to be loop that came out loop.

columns.name: sse_accuracy.n_conditioned_atoms
columns.description: Number of atoms you gave a secondary-structure condition.

columns.name: sequence_probability_adherence.n_zero_conditions
columns.description: Number of position and identity pairs you excluded.

columns.name: sequence_probability_adherence.n_one_conditions
columns.description: Number of positions where you required one specific identity.

columns.name: search.reward
columns.description: Score the guided search gave this design when choosing which candidates to keep. Higher ranked better, and the scale depends on the search setting you chose.

columns.name: search_stage
columns.description: Which part of the guided search produced this design: the final selection or a candidate kept from an earlier checkpoint.

columns.name: pass_ppi_binder_ptm
columns.description: 1 if the limit on binder pTM (at least 80) was met, 0 if not, blank if it could not be computed.

columns.name: pass_ppi_interface_pae
columns.description: 1 if the limit on minimum interface PAE (at most 1.5 Å) was met, 0 if not, blank if it could not be computed.

columns.name: pass_ppi_binder_rmsd
columns.description: 1 if the limit on binder RMSD after aligning the target backbone (at most 2.5 Å) was met, 0 if not, blank if it could not be computed.

columns.name: refolded_backbone_rmsd.rmsd
columns.description: Backbone deviation, in Å, between the design and its refolded structure. Lower means the designed sequence folds back into the design.

columns.name: refolded_target_aligned_binder_rmsd.rmsd
columns.description: All-atom deviation, in Å, of the binder between the design and its refold after aligning on the target. Lower is closer.

columns.name: refolded_target_backbone_aligned_binder_rmsd.rmsd
columns.description: Deviation, in Å, of the binder between the design and its refold after aligning on the target backbone. Lower is closer.

columns.name: oracle_ppi.plddt_coi
columns.description: How confident the folding model is in the designed chain in the refold, from 0 to 100. Higher is more confident.

columns.name: oracle_ppi.ptm_coi
columns.description: Predicted TM-score of the designed chain in the refold, from 0 to 100. Higher is better.

columns.name: oracle_ppi.min_ipae_coi
columns.description: Lowest predicted aligned error, in Å, between the designed chain and another chain in the refold. Lower means a more confident interface.

columns.name: oracle_ppi.iptm_coi
columns.description: Predicted interface TM-score between the designed chain and the rest of the refold, from 0 to 100. Higher is better.

columns.name: interface_energy.interface_ddg
columns.description: Physics-based energy of the contacts between the designed chain and its partner, in Rosetta energy units. Lower is more favorable. Compare designs within one job.

columns.name: interface_energy.fa_elec
columns.description: Electrostatic part of the interface energy. Lower is more favorable.

columns.name: interface_energy.n_interface_elec_interactions
columns.description: Number of residue pairs across the interface whose electrostatic energy is below -0.2. More means more favorable charge contacts.

columns.name: sequence_developability.gravy
columns.description: Average hydrophobicity of the designed sequence on the Kyte-Doolittle scale. Lower is more soluble. Blank for designs with several chains.

columns.name: sequence_developability.instability_index
columns.description: Instability predicted from the designed sequence's neighboring residue pairs. Below 40 predicts a stable protein. Blank for designs with several chains.

columns.name: favored_residues
columns.description: Share of the designed chain that is each amino acid you asked to favor, with the share you asked for, for example W 12% (asked 10%).

columns.name: specificity_passed
columns.description: 1 if every structure you named behaved as you asked, 0 if one did not, blank if one could not be scored.

columns.name: closest_avoided_target
columns.description: The structure to avoid that the design came closest to binding, named after its file. Blank if you named none.

columns.name: closest_avoided_interface_error
columns.description: Lowest predicted aligned error, in Å, at the interface with the avoided structure the design came closest to binding. Higher means the folding model finds no interface.

columns.name: weakest_wanted_target
columns.description: The structure to also bind that the design bound least well, named after its file. Blank if you named none.

columns.name: weakest_wanted_interface_error
columns.description: Lowest predicted aligned error, in Å, at the interface with the structure to also bind that the design bound least well. Lower means a more confident interface.

outputs.byTaskNote: This tool's output depends on the task it runs. byTask is authoritative for the task you set, and each entry is COMPLETE — a task that does not redeclare mainCSV/taskType inherits the tool's top-level value (the top-level `taskType` field and this block's `mainCSV`). The top-level taskType and this block's mainCSV/produces summarize ACROSS tasks — produces is the union over every task's output — as a column OR as a file alongside the CSV — and taskType/mainCSV are the tool's top-level declaration, which is not guaranteed to be the task selector's default. Do not read them as describing the run you are about to submit. `generates` is what a task creates fresh (empty for a scoring task, whose table may still echo its input). A column carrying a `tasks` list appears only in those tasks; an untagged column is simply not task-gated in the tool's declaration, which does not promise every task fills it — read `generates` for what a task actually produces. An ABSENT `generates` means the tool declared none for that task, not that the task generates nothing.
